content.short: Rocketpad is a Cardano-based fundraising platform and a project accelerator, designed to leverage DeFi innovations.
content.description: ROCKETPAD is a Cardano-based IDO Launchpad and a project accelerator, designed to leverage DeFi innovations to provide transparent, efficient, and fully decentralised crowdfunding services that aims to fundraise Cardano based projects with or without the need for KYC. Unlike our competitors, we offer full support of Cardano native tokens and a suite of advanced DeFi tools that upcoming projects needs. ROCKETPAD is set to mature into the cornerstone of the new Cardano-dominated DeFi landscape.
content.meta: Find out about Rocketpad (Rocket) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
